Senior Data Engineer

About the job:

Versatile is an innovative AI-driven construction intelligence startup, committed to transforming the construction industry with cutting-edge technology. Our mission is to enhance the efficiency, safety, and productivity of construction projects through intelligent solutions.

We’re hiring a hands-on Senior Data Engineer who wants to build data products that move the needle in the physical world. Your work will help construction professionals make better, data-backed decisions every day.

Responsibilities:

  • Lead the design and development of scalable data pipelines.
  • Collaborate with Product, Data Science, and Analytics teams.
  • Build and optimize workflows using Databricks, Spark, Kafka, and AWS.
  • Implement real-time and batch processing architectures.
  • Develop and maintain ingestion pipelines from multiple sources.
  • Manage deployment and performance of data infrastructure.
  • Use Terraform to manage infrastructure-as-code.
  • Prepare data for analytics and product-facing use cases.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of experience working with large-scale data systems.
  • Strong experience with PySpark, Kafka, and Databricks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Python and SQL.
  • Experience with AWS cloud services.
  • Hands-on experience with Spark on Kubernetes.
  • Experience with Apache Kafka and Kafka connectors.
  • Knowledge of modern data architecture principles.
  • BSc or higher in Computer Science or related field.
Account Manager

About the job:

Versatile is an innovative AI-driven construction intelligence startup committed to transforming the construction industry with cutting-edge technology. Our mission is to enhance construction projects’ efficiency, safety, and productivity through intelligent solutions.

We are looking for a dynamic and motivated Account Manager to drive growth and strengthen customer relationships within the construction industry. In this role, you will work closely with customers, lead consultative sales efforts, and help expand Versatile’s presence across assigned territories.

Responsibilities:

  • Manage outside face-to-face sales within assigned territories.
  • Build account development plans for customer hierarchies and strategic growth.
  • Work closely with the VP Sales to implement enterprise agreements.
  • Conduct consultative selling and customer solution presentations.
  • Lead in-person demonstrations of Versatile’s technology solutions.
  • Identify key stakeholders and decision-makers on construction sites.
  • Collaborate with Product, Logistics, Credit, Marketing, Technical Services, and Customer Success teams.
  • Represent Versatile at construction industry events and trade organizations.

Requirements:

  • 3+ years of B2B sales or account management experience in construction technology.
  • Experience developing and executing structured sales processes.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or related field.
  • Experience using CRM tools such as HubSpot or Salesforce.
  • Familiarity with AI tools like ChatGPT, Gemini, or Microsoft Copilot.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Understanding of construction workflows and technology adoption.
  • Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and customer relationships.
  • Willingness to travel up to 50% within the assigned territory.
Senior Product Manager

About the job:

Versatile is an innovative construction intelligence startup, committed to transforming the construction industry with cutting-edge technology. Our mission is to enhance the efficiency, safety, and productivity of construction projects through intelligent solutions.

The construction industry is at an inflection point. Demand is surging - driven by the AI and data center buildout, the reshoring of US manufacturing, and large-scale infrastructure investment - while supply is tightening across materials and skilled labor. In this environment, protecting margins and cashflow is no longer a nice-to-have, it’s existential.

Versatile is built for exactly this moment. Our product makes performance data effortless to capture and actionable at scale. Headquartered in Tel Aviv and backed by prominent investors, we’re at a stage where the product-market fit is proven, the customer base is strong, and the opportunity ahead is massive.

We’re looking for a Senior Product Manager to help us build on that momentum, someone with the drive to lead products that matter, the instincts to cut through the noise and focus on what moves the needle, and the leadership to drive execution across a global, multi-disciplinary team.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own and drive the product roadmap for a core product area - from ideation through delivery.
  • Collaborate across engineering, design, operations, sales, and go-to-market to identify, shape, and deliver high-impact product initiatives.
  • Build a deep understanding of users and the market, and turn that understanding into a product people actually use.
  • Drive end-to-end execution - build trust, remove blockers, and hold the bar on quality and timelines.
  • Contribute to the overall product strategy by bringing customer insight, data, and sharp cost-benefit judgment to strategic discussions.

Requirements:

  • 8+ years of hands-on product management experience. You’ve shipped products that mattered and can point to the impact.
  • You’ve owned a product at a meaningful revenue scale and know what it takes to keep a mature product moving forward through real complexity.
  • Strong product and UX sense. You see the line between what users ask for and what actually drives long-term value, and you’re obsessed with intuitive user experience.
  • Resourceful and relentless. You break through walls, work outside formal boundaries, and find a way when there isn’t an obvious one.
  • Effective leadership. You build trust fast and are able to rally individuals and teams around a joint mission.
  • Analytical and data-driven mindset. You’re comfortable working with metrics, usage patterns, and qualitative insights.
  • Excellent English communication. You can walk a room through a hard trade-off and leave everyone aligned, whether they’re technical or not.
  • Robust technical background. You’re comfortable engaging with engineers across hardware, firmware, AI, data pipelines, web, and mobile. You don’t need experience in all of these, but you need the depth to lead product decisions across a complex stack.
  • Curious and adaptive. You don’t cling to playbooks, you’re always looking for better ways to build products, especially as AI reshapes what’s possible.

 

Headquartered in Los Altos | Boca Raton | Tel Aviv
